```{r cache load}
# Re-running the chr*/{gene}/{results,junction_results,n_bb_tests}.tsv +
# res.RDS walks takes a long time. The chunk at the bottom of this Rmd
# (`save cache`) dumps every slow-computed object plus the input file
# lists into a single RDS so we can short-circuit on the next knit.
# Delete CACHE_FILE to force a full rebuild.
CACHE_FILE <- "gene_cancer_type_hits_cache.RDS"
USE_CACHE  <- file.exists(CACHE_FILE)

if (USE_CACHE) {
  cat("Loading cached objects from", CACHE_FILE, "\n")
  .cache <- readRDS(CACHE_FILE)
  for (nm in names(.cache)) assign(nm, .cache[[nm]])
  rm(.cache)
  cat("Loaded:", paste(ls(pattern = "^(tsv_files|all_results|junc_files|all_junctions|n_bb_files|n_tests|sig_junctions|res_files|processed_paths|processed_genes)$"),
                       collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

## Aggregate per-(gene, cancer_type) Poisson hits

Walks every `chr*/{gene}/results.tsv` produced by the per-gene Poisson
factor pipeline (one level up, in `gene_level_poisson/`), concatenates
them, and writes the canonical hit table consumed by the `Snakefile`
(`config.yaml::paths.cosmic_sig_tsv`).

```{r aggregate sig results}
# Rmd cwd = gene_level_analysis/. Per-gene chr*/ outputs live in ../quetzal_runs/gene_level/.
root_dir <- "../quetzal_runs/gene_level"

if (!USE_CACHE) {
  tsv_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(root_dir, "chr*", "*", "results.tsv"))

  all_results <- rbindlist(
    lapply(tsv_files, function(f) {
      if (file.size(f) == 0) return(NULL)
      tryCatch(fread(f), error = function(e) NULL)
    }),
    fill      = TRUE,
    use.names = TRUE,
    idcol     = "source_file"
  )

  colnames(all_results) <- c(
    "source_file", "gene_name", "cancer_type", "factor",
    "factor_coefficient", "pvalue", "num_sig_juncs_in_factor",
    "max_delta_psi", "max_psi_fc", "chr"
  )
}

write_tsv(all_results, "gene_level_poisson_sig_results.tsv")
cat("Wrote gene_level_poisson_sig_results.tsv (",
    nrow(all_results), "rows,",
    dplyr::n_distinct(all_results$gene_name), "distinct genes)\n")
```

## TSG aberrant-splicing candidates

```{r tsg candidates}
cosmic_tier_1 <- fread("../inputs/cosmic_tier_1.tsv", data.table = FALSE)

to_check_out <- cosmic_tier_1 %>%
  filter(grepl("TSG", `Role in Cancer`)) %>%
  inner_join(all_results, by = c("Gene Symbol" = "gene_name")) %>%
  # Cohort eligibility is decided upstream (cancer_specific_factors.R tests
  # only cohorts with a matched GTEx tissue); no extra exclusions here.
  filter(max_delta_psi > 0.1,
         max_psi_fc    > 2)

just_cancer_types <- to_check_out %>%
  dplyr::select(`Gene Symbol`,
                `Tumour Types(Somatic)`,
                `Tumour Types(Germline)`,
                cancer_type, chr)

write_tsv(just_cancer_types, "tsg_aberrant_splicing_candidates.tsv")
cat("Wrote tsg_aberrant_splicing_candidates.tsv (",
    nrow(just_cancer_types), "rows)\n")
```

## Aggregate junction-level results

`junction_results.tsv` is written per (gene, factor, cancer_type) hit by
`cancer_specific_factors.R`. Each row is one junction × hit combination,
with a beta-binomial GTEx-vs-TCGA test (`bb_beta`, `bb_pvalue`).
Concatenate them, apply Bonferroni across all tested junctions, and
keep only those upregulated in TCGA (`bb_beta > 0`).

```{r aggregate junction results}
if (!USE_CACHE) {
  junc_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(root_dir, "chr*", "*",
                                   "junction_results.tsv"))
  junc_files <- junc_files[file.size(junc_files) > 0]

  all_junctions <- rbindlist(
    lapply(junc_files, function(f) {
      tryCatch(fread(f), error = function(e) NULL)
    }),
    fill      = TRUE,
    use.names = TRUE
  )

  # Bonferroni denominator = total BB tests actually performed across all
  # (factor, cohort) hits, recorded per-gene by cancer_specific_factors.R.
  # nrow(all_junctions) under-counted: it only included junctions in hits
  # that *also* had >=1 significant junction, not the discarded ones.
  n_bb_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(root_dir, "chr*", "*", "n_bb_tests.tsv"))
  n_tests <- sum(vapply(n_bb_files, function(f) {
    if (file.size(f) == 0) return(0L)
    as.integer(fread(f, data.table = FALSE)$n_bb_tests[1])
  }, integer(1)))

  all_junctions[, bb_pvalue_bonf := pmin(bb_pvalue * n_tests, 1)]

  sig_junctions <- all_junctions[bb_pvalue_bonf < 0.05 & bb_beta > 0]
}

cat("Junction-level rows loaded            :", nrow(all_junctions), "\n")
cat("Total BB tests performed              :", n_tests, "\n")
cat("Bonferroni-significant:",
    sum(all_junctions$bb_pvalue_bonf < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  of which upregulated in TCGA        :", nrow(sig_junctions), "\n")
cat("Distinct genes among upregulated hits :",
    dplyr::n_distinct(sig_junctions$gene_name), "\n")

sig_facts <- sig_junctions %>%
  mutate(gene_cohort_fact = paste0(gene_name, '-', factor, '-', cancer_type)) %>%
  pull(gene_cohort_fact) %>%
  unique() %>%
  length()
write_tsv(sig_junctions, "junction_level_sig_upregulated.tsv")
```

```{r number of unique junction groups ID-ed}
sig_junctions <- fread("junction_level_sig_upregulated.tsv", data.table = F)
unique_ks <- unique(paste0(sig_junctions$gene_name, '-', sig_junctions$factor))

```
## Process counts and COSMIC tier-1 enrichment (junction-level filter)

```{r counts and enrichment}
# A gene was actually processed if its res.RDS is non-trivial. Empty /
# tiny res.RDS files come from genes where the Poisson fit didn't run.
if (!USE_CACHE) {
  res_files <- Sys.glob(file.path(root_dir, "chr*", "*", "res.RDS"))
  processed_paths <- res_files[file.size(res_files) > 100]
  processed_genes <- unique(basename(dirname(processed_paths)))
}
n_processed     <- length(processed_genes)

# Significant gene set = genes with >=1 Bonferroni-surviving, TCGA-up junction
sig_genes <- unique(sig_junctions$gene_name)
sig_genes <- sig_genes[!is.na(sig_genes)]
n_sig_genes <- length(sig_genes)

# COSMIC tier 1 overlap
cosmic_genes        <- cosmic_tier_1$`Gene Symbol`
processed_in_cosmic <- intersect(processed_genes, cosmic_genes)
sig_cosmic_genes    <- intersect(sig_genes, cosmic_genes)

cat("Genes processed (res.RDS > 100 bytes)  :", n_processed,            "\n")
cat("  in COSMIC tier 1                     :", length(processed_in_cosmic), "\n")
cat("Genes with >=1 Bonferroni-up junction  :", n_sig_genes,            "\n")
cat("  in COSMIC tier 1                     :", length(sig_cosmic_genes), "\n")

# 2x2 contingency: of all genes processed, do COSMIC tier-1 genes have a
# higher rate of carrying a Bonferroni-significant TCGA-up junction?
a <- length(intersect(sig_genes, processed_in_cosmic))            # COSMIC + sig
b <- length(processed_in_cosmic) - a                              # COSMIC + not sig
non_cosmic_processed <- setdiff(processed_genes, cosmic_genes)
c <- length(intersect(sig_genes, non_cosmic_processed))           # non-COSMIC + sig
d <- length(non_cosmic_processed) - c                             # non-COSMIC + not sig

contingency <- matrix(
  c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(c("COSMIC tier 1", "non-COSMIC"),
                  c("up-junc", "no up-junc"))
)
print(contingency)

chi <- chisq.test(contingency)
print(chi)

odds_ratio <- (a * d) / (b * c)
cat(sprintf("\nOdds ratio (COSMIC up vs non-COSMIC up): %.3f\n",
            odds_ratio))
cat(sprintf("Up-junction rate among COSMIC tier 1: %d / %d = %.1f%%\n",
            a, length(processed_in_cosmic),
            100 * a / max(1, length(processed_in_cosmic))))
cat(sprintf("Up-junction rate among non-COSMIC   : %d / %d = %.1f%%\n",
            c, length(non_cosmic_processed),
            100 * c / max(1, length(non_cosmic_processed))))
```
## COSMIC tier-1 tumour suppressors only

```{r tsg enrichment}
# Same 2x2 / chi-squared design as above, restricted to COSMIC tier-1 genes
# whose Role in Cancer includes "TSG" (TSG-only and dual-role genes), and
# compared against the same non-COSMIC background (other COSMIC genes are
# left out of both rows so they do not dilute either group).
tsg_genes           <- cosmic_tier_1$`Gene Symbol`[grepl("TSG", cosmic_tier_1$`Role in Cancer`)]
processed_tsg       <- intersect(processed_genes, tsg_genes)
a_t <- length(intersect(sig_genes, processed_tsg))   # TSG + sig
b_t <- length(processed_tsg) - a_t                   # TSG + not sig
contingency_tsg <- matrix(
  c(a_t, b_t, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(c("COSMIC tier 1 TSG", "non-COSMIC"),
                  c("up-junc", "no up-junc"))
)
print(contingency_tsg)
chi_tsg        <- chisq.test(contingency_tsg)
odds_ratio_tsg <- (a_t * d) / (b_t * c)
print(chi_tsg)
cat(sprintf("TSG odds ratio: %.3f | up-junction rate %d / %d = %.1f%% (non-COSMIC %.1f%%)\n",
            odds_ratio_tsg, a_t, length(processed_tsg),
            100 * a_t / max(1, length(processed_tsg)),
            100 * c / max(1, length(non_cosmic_processed))))
```

## Manuscript-ready summary

```{r manuscript summary}
# One block of numbers to plug into the results paragraph:
#   - junction groups        = unique (gene_name, factor) hits
#   - genes                  = distinct gene_names carrying any hit
#   - COSMIC tier 1 overlap  = those genes intersected with COSMIC
#   - odds ratio             = odds_ratio from the 2x2 in `counts and enrichment`
#   - p-value                = chi-sq p from the same 2x2
n_unique_ks  <- dplyr::n_distinct(
  paste0(sig_junctions$gene_name, "-", sig_junctions$factor))
n_sig_genes  <- dplyr::n_distinct(sig_junctions$gene_name)
n_cosmic_hit <- length(sig_cosmic_genes)

cat(sprintf("\n========= Manuscript-ready summary =========\n"))
cat(sprintf("Unique junction groups (gene-factor pairs)   : %s\n",
            format(n_unique_ks,  big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Distinct genes with >=1 Bonferroni-up junction: %s\n",
            format(n_sig_genes,  big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("Of which COSMIC tier 1                        : %s\n",
            format(n_cosmic_hit, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("COSMIC-vs-non-COSMIC odds ratio               : %.2f\n",
            odds_ratio))
cat(sprintf("Chi-squared p-value for that enrichment       : %.3g\n",
            chi$p.value))
cat(sprintf("============================================\n\n"))

cat(sprintf(
"Suggested sentence:
  We identified %s junction groups in %s genes that showed cancer-type-
  associated splicing independent of the normal tissue variation. These
  genes were significantly enriched for COSMIC Tier 1 cancer genes
  (%s genes; odds ratio %.1f, p = %.2g, chi-squared test), including
  tumour suppressors (%s genes; odds ratio %.1f, p = %.2g).\n",
  format(n_unique_ks,  big.mark = ","),
  format(n_sig_genes,  big.mark = ","),
  format(n_cosmic_hit, big.mark = ","),
  odds_ratio, chi$p.value,
  format(a_t, big.mark = ","), odds_ratio_tsg, chi_tsg$p.value))
```

## Cache everything needed to recreate the numerical analyses

```{r save cache}
# One RDS holding the slow-to-compute objects + the input file lists they
# came from. Loaded near the top of this Rmd via `cache load` so the next
# knit doesn't re-walk thousands of chr*/{gene}/{results,junction_results,
# n_bb_tests}.tsv files. Delete CACHE_FILE to force a full rebuild.
cache_objects <- list(
  # ---- File-list provenance ----
  tsv_files       = tsv_files,         # chr*/{gene}/results.tsv inputs
  junc_files      = junc_files,        # chr*/{gene}/junction_results.tsv inputs
  n_bb_files      = n_bb_files,        # chr*/{gene}/n_bb_tests.tsv inputs
  res_files       = res_files,         # chr*/{gene}/res.RDS inputs (all)
  processed_paths = processed_paths,   # subset of res_files with size > 100B

  # ---- Aggregated tables / counts ----
  all_results      = all_results,      # gene-level Poisson sig table
  all_junctions    = all_junctions,    # junction-level BB results
  n_tests          = n_tests,          # total BB tests for Bonferroni denom
  sig_junctions    = sig_junctions,    # Bonferroni-up, TCGA-up junctions
  processed_genes  = processed_genes   # unique gene_names with res.RDS > 100B
)

saveRDS(cache_objects, CACHE_FILE)
cat("Saved cache to", CACHE_FILE, ":\n")
str(cache_objects, max.level = 1, give.attr = FALSE)
```
